name: Hold My Court
author: gnault

sections.description:
Hold My Court is a simple, lightweight WordPress plugin that enables clubs, HOAs, and community organizations to manage reservations for multiple courts or activity spaces.

Perfect for tennis, pickleball, bocce, horseshoes, racquetball, or any other court-based activity, this plugin provides an affordable, easy-to-use alternative to expensive SaaS booking platforms. With Hold My Court, you keep full control of your reservations directly on your own WordPress website.

Features

  • Reserve multiple courts with customizable time slots.
  • Works for tennis, pickleball, bocce, horseshoes, and other activities.
  • Tailored for clubs and HOAs of all sizes.
  • Lightweight and simple — no bloated features or complexity.
  • Affordable one-time purchase, no recurring SaaS costs.
  • Keep full control of your reservations within WordPress.

The goal is to provide clubs with a modern, affordable booking system that is easy for admins to set up and intuitive for members to use.

Support

This plugin is provided free via WordPress.org. Support is offered on a best-effort basis through the WordPress.org Support Forum.

Free support includes:
* Basic installation and setup help
* Bug/security fixes
* Updates for WordPress compatibility
sections.faq:
Can I use this for different sports?

Yes! The plugin is designed to support any activity that uses reservable courts or fields, including tennis, pickleball, bocce, racquetball, or horseshoes.

Does it support multiple courts?

The basic version allows you to schedule up to 4 courts, while the full version enables you to schedule up to 24.

Can I customize the booking time slots?

Absolutely. You can tailor the time slots to match your club’s hours and scheduling needs.

Does it require a subscription?

No, this is a one-time purchase plugin. You host and control everything on your own WordPress site.
